panels.description: Night at a lakeside boathouse in 2099. Older Alex grips a mooring post as TJ steps from the dock and separates mid-stride; Alex's granddaughter stands behind him in a blanket. Leave the upper third of the dock and lake clear for sound lettering.

Close on the granddaughter and older Alex, with a tanker barge and two siphon drones working beneath white lamps across Lake Keel. Keep their faces clear and leave the upper-left lake area open for dialogue.

TJ's head glides ahead while his torso and legs travel independently toward the barge along the dock edge. Keep the separated dog-shaped parts readable and leave sky and water space for sound lettering.
The granddaughter catches older Alex's sleeve; he keeps watching the distant tanker and drones instead of turning. Leave the upper third open for the exchange.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Let’s see what they came to take.
